name: The Fly - U2
guitar: Bridge pickup; humbuckers are a useful starting point, but no specific recording guitar is assumed

efx.notes: A sharp, gritty distortion approximation for the song's abrasive guitar texture.

guitar_settings.notes: Starting point only; adjust pickup and tone controls to suit your guitar.

playing_notes: Use a tight, percussive attack and let the chord notes stay distinct. The slow phaser is a playable approximation of the layered, naturally phasing opening guitar texture, not an exact recreation of the studio process.

sources.reference_note: The article describes the abrasive guitar sound and says the opening phasing was created by layering additional guitar over the existing part. Exact recording gear is not asserted here; the NUX models and settings are tone-match approximations.
